Struct Direction

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Structs
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a 2D direction using integer horizontal and vertical components. Provides utility methods and operators for direction manipulation and comparison.

public readonly struct Direction : IEquatable<Direction>

Remarks

Useful for grid-based movement, direction checks, and vector math in 2D space.
